component.name: Slowly
component.summary: Coherence breathing trainer for focus and calm

description.p: Slowly guides coherence breathing — a rhythm shown to improve heart rate variability, reduce stress, and deepen focus. Choose from presets or dial in your own timing, then follow the expanding circle.
Audio includes brown noise, theta-frequency binaural beats, and a sub-bass breathing drone, all synthesized in real time with no samples or network access required.
